name: James King
source:
A very open person. He talks a lot about his life, and always wants to know about my day. He uses a fork instead of a spoon for pretty much everything.

He acts differently around me then he does around Vincent.

He talks passionately about what he likes. He is very loud and can often be heard talking across a crowded room. 

[From Idril's Phone Contacts In-Game]
